reason: The headline is false and the fix is wrong about the source. (1) The title's claim is already closed and gate-proven. Driven in chromium at 1440 on ?v=light&state=error, holding the pointer down on #retry: background goes #ffffff -> rgb(244,244,245), border goes rgba(17,17,17,0.1) -> solid rgb(113,113,122), transform becomes matrix(1,0,0,1,0,1), el.matches(':active') true, over the declared 140ms curve (lately.html:440). That is a designed press. 'no-pressed-state-anywhere' was confirmed and fixed in r1 and interaction-check.mjs:1325 asserts '.btn:active' exists; the finding restates a gate assertion and re-raises a closed finding with no regression evidence. (2) The residue -- no in-flight treatment -- is not undesigned either. The pending treatment for this reading IS a designed state: `loading`, with skeletons at the real geometry of the sections that will render plus its own role=status 'Loading this reading.' line (lately.html:973-975). A retry re-enters that. The finding asks instead for a second, button-local pending vocabulary for the same wait. (3) The inertness is the master's declared position, not an oversight. Driven, every control on this surface is inert by construction: the three tabs are href='#', a.kpi is href='#' (l.693), the marks call preventDefault on click (l.1134), and 'Open Tasks' on the empty state leaves the DOM byte-identical exactly as #retry does. The round notes already state the rule -- 'The hero no longer says a finished job is openable, because nothing on this surface opens one. That is on the port packet, not on the screen.' Retry's wiring is the same class. (4) The proposed fix is factually wrong three times over. 'the button, the note block and the status line all exist' -- in the error state the only live region in the DOM is the role=alert wrapper (driven); there is no role=status element (loading's lives inside loading's own template), and a live region injected and populated in the same frame is unreliably announced, so the fix would ship an announcement that does not announce. There is no note block on the error card either: it is heading + paragraph + button, 3048 characters, nothing else. 'aria-disabled=true, pointer events off' would strand the ring on a dead control -- #retry is the only focusable thing in the error state's main (driven order: 3 tabs, then #retry) and aria-disabled leaves it in the tab order, so Enter still does nothing: the complaint reinstated, one indirection deeper. And 'Asked again at 09:16.' is a hand-typed wall clock on a surface whose only reading instant is the frozen fixture literal F.readingLong = '09:14, Thursday 16 July 2026' (fixture.js:27), printed by shell() in the same view twice (l.892, l.902) and declared bound in the coverage footer. Two clock times two minutes apart on a static frame with no elapsed time is the class that got 'error-state-invents-a-last-good-reading' and 'august-inside-a-july-reading' confirmed in r1; the fix would reopen both. (5) The severity is overstated. 'defect' means visibly wrong but passable; nothing in the error frame is visibly wrong. The ask is an eighth state plus live wiring on a master where nothing is wired, which is a build on the port packet, not a defect on the screen.
sharpenedFix: Drop the button-local spinner entirely. If anything here is worth spending on, it is the repeat-failure sentence, and it belongs in the port packet's spec rather than in this master: on press, replace the card with the existing `loading` state -- that is already the designed pending treatment and it already owns the role=status announcement -- and on a second failure return to the error card with one extra line in the existing t-body dim-2 voice, no clock literal and no new component: 'Asked again. Tasks still did not answer.' Bind that string through fixture.js/derive-fixture.mjs like every other string on the surface, never typed inline. Leave #retry enabled with its label unchanged: it is the only focusable control in the state, and pointer-events:none on a focused control is a worse outcome than the one being fixed.
breaks: If it were built as the seat wrote it: the error frame stops being deterministic (a wall-clock string in a shot pipeline), and light-error--1440x960.png plus every dark/motion permutation would need re-shooting and would still differ run to run; derive-fixture.mjs's scope-versus-marks guard does not cover an inline literal, so the contradiction with 'Read at 09:14' would ship unguarded. pointer-events:none on the focused #retry breaks the error state's focus model -- re-measure the focus-order and focus-visible assertions in interaction-check.mjs, and the 'every visible interactive element has an accessible name' audit (l.116) against an aria-disabled control. An injected role=status inside the role=alert card gives the error state two live regions, which risks re-opening 'chart-is-announced-twice' and 'terminal-states-lose-their-heading-and-announce-nothing' from r1 -- re-run the announcement assertions for all seven states. If the sharpened version is built instead, re-measure only: the audit's hit-target and contrast checks on the taller error card, and the vertical-rhythm ladder for the added line.
